candidates.source_description:
I visited Gandhi Smriti in Delhi and explored the room where Mahatma Gandhi lived during his final days, along with the place where he was assassinated on 30 January 1948.

In this video, I’ve shown the historic location, Gandhi Ji’s room, and some important moments connected to his final days.

A place filled with history, memories and an important chapter of India’s past. 🇮🇳

Watch till the end and experience Gandhi Smriti with me.

#MahatmaGandhi #GandhiSmriti #Gandhi #Delhi #IndianHistory #H
